# Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
## Rental Management System for IT Equipment Rental Services

**Version:** 1.0  
**Date:** 2026-07-02  
**Prepared For:** Rental Services Business  
**Prepared By:** Claude Code  

---

## Table of Contents
1. [Introduction](#1-introduction)
   - 1.1 Purpose
   - 1.2 Scope
   - 1.3 Definitions, Acronyms, and Abbreviations
   - 1.4 References
   - 1.5 Overview
2. [Overall Description](#2-overall-description)

   - 2.4 Operating Environment
   - 2.5 Design and Implementation Constraints
   - 2.6 User Documentation
   - 2.7 Assumptions and Dependencies
3. [Specific Requirements](#3-specific-requirements)
   - 3.1 External Interface Requirements
   - 3.2 Functional Requirements
   - 3.3 Non-Functional Requirements
   - 3.4 Other Requirements

---

## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose
This document specifies the software requirements for a Rental Management System (RMS) designed specifically for an IT equipment rental services business. The system will manage the rental operations for servers, laptops, computers, firewalls, printers, and refurbished IT equipment serving business customers including IT companies, manufacturing firms, startups, educational institutions, and BPOs/call centers.

### 1.2 Scope
The Rental Management System will provide:
- Inventory management for all rental equipment
- Customer and contract management
- Rental transaction processing
- Billing and invoicing
- Maintenance and repair tracking
- Reporting and analytics
- Integration with the existing customer-facing website
- User role-based access control

The system will **not** serve individual consumers; it is strictly for business-to-business (B2B) transactions.

### 1.3 Definitions, Acronyms, and Abbreviations

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| RMS | Rental Management System |
| B2B | Business-to-Business |
| CRM | Customer Relationship Management |
| ERP | Enterprise Resource Planning |
| SLA | Service Level Agreement |
| OEM | Original Equipment Manufacturer |
| SLA | Service Level Agreement |

### 1.4 References
- [IEEE 830-1998] IEEE Recommended Practice for Software Requirements Specifications
- Existing website: `index.html`, `style.css`, `main.js`
- Brand assets: `icons/` directory containing brand logos

### 1.5 Overview
The remainder of this document describes the overall description of the product (Section 2) and the specific requirements (Section 3) including external interfaces, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, and other requirements.

---

## 2. Overall Description

### 2.1 Product Perspective
The Rental Management System is a web-based application designed to operate as the backend system for the rental services business. It will integrate with the existing customer-facing website (currently at `index.html`) to provide real-time inventory availability, rental requests, and customer account management.

The system will be a multi-user application accessible via web browsers, with different interfaces for administrators, staff, and customers (via portal access).

### 2.2 Product Functions
The RMS will provide the following core functions:
1. **Inventory Management** - Track all rental equipment by type, brand, model, serial number, condition, and availability
2. **Customer Management** - Maintain B2B customer profiles, contact information, rental history, and credit terms
3. **Rental Management** - Handle rental requests, quotations, contracts, equipment allocation, pickup/delivery scheduling, and returns
4. **Billing and Invoicing** - Generate invoices, process payments, track overdue payments, and manage security deposits
5. **Maintenance Management** - Track equipment maintenance, repairs, servicing schedules, and warranty claims
6. **Reporting and Analytics** - Generate reports on utilization, revenue, customer analytics, and inventory performance
7. **Customer Portal** - Allow customers to browse inventory, request rentals, view active rentals, and make payments
8. **Integration** - Synchronize with the existing website to display real-time availability and product information

### 2.3 User Classes and Characteristics

| User Type | Characteristics | Permissions |
|-----------|----------------|-------------|
| **System Administrator** | IT staff responsible for system configuration, user management, and system maintenance | Full system access including user management, system configuration, and all business functions |
| **Rental Manager** | Business users managing rental operations, inventory, and customer relationships | Full access to rental, inventory, customer, and billing functions; limited system administration |
| **Sales Representative** | Staff handling customer inquiries, quotations, and rental agreements | Access to customer management, rental quotations, and contract creation |
| **Operations Staff** | Personnel handling equipment preparation, delivery, pickup, and maintenance | Access to inventory management, equipment status updates, and maintenance scheduling |
| **Accounting/Finance** | Staff handling invoicing, payments, and financial reporting | Access to billing, invoicing, payment processing, and financial reports |
| **Customer Portal User** | Authorized representatives from B2B customers | Browse inventory, submit rental requests, view active rentals, download invoices, and make payments |

### 2.4 Operating Environment
- **Web Application:** Browser-based interface accessible via modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- **Deployment:** Web server (Apache/Nginx) with application server (Node.js/PHP/Python)
- **Database:** Relational database (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MariaDB)

### 1.1 Purpose
This document specifies the software requirements for a Rental Management System (RMS) designed specifically for an IT equipment rental services business. The system will manage the rental operations for servers, laptops, computers, firewalls, printers, and refurbished IT equipment serving business customers including IT companies, manufacturing firms, startups, educational institutions, and BPOs/call centers.

### 1.2 Scope
The Rental Management System will provide:
- Inventory management for all rental equipment
- Customer and contract management
- Rental transaction processing
- Billing and invoicing
- Maintenance and repair tracking
- Reporting and analytics
- Integration with the existing customer-facing website

The Rental Management System is a web-based application designed to operate as the backend system for the rental services business. 3. **Rental Management** - Handle rental requests, quotations, contracts, equipment allocation, pickup/delivery scheduling, and returns
4. **Billing and Invoicing** - Generate invoices, process payments, track overdue payments, and manage security deposits
5. **Maintenance Management** - Track equipment maintenance, repairs, servicing schedules, and warranty claims
6. **Reporting and Analytics** - Generate reports on utilization, revenue, customer analytics, and inventory performance
